evidence.quote: The last ferry moves from 22:40 to 21:55 on weekdays from November.

observations.why: States the timetable change as settled fact, supplying the schedule and the ridership rationale rather than arguing for it.

evidence.quote: Friday and Saturday late sailings still fill.

observations.why: Justifies keeping the weekend timetable by pointing to observed occupancy, an evidence-based argument for the decision.
